clos.loDetails: Understand the fundamental ideas of the finite element method
Apply in analyzing the Civil eingineering structures and variable practical disciplines such as Pipeline, pressure vessel, shipbuilding, aerospace, etc.
Analyze the principle in deriving the stiffness matrix, mass matrix, of 1D,2D,3D finite element, static and dynamic loads
Evaluate the stresses and strain, dynamic behaviors, the static bending, shearing of structures.
